name: Donchian Breakout with ATR-Based Chandelier Stop
description: Long-only breakout strategy that enters on Donchian Channel upper band breakout and exits using either a Chandelier trailing stop or Donchian lower band breakdown. Position sizing is volatility-adjusted to risk 2% per trade.
source:
# Donchian Breakout with ATR-Based Chandelier Stop
# Long-only breakout strategy with volatility-adjusted position sizing

# Data source
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# Donchian Channel (20-day)
dc_upper, dc_middle, dc_lower = donchian_channel(window=20)()

# ATR for position sizing (5-period as specified)
atr_5 = atr(period=5)()

# Chandelier Exit (using 20-bar lookback with 5-period ATR and 3x multiplier)
chandelier_long, chandelier_short, chandelier_dir = chandelier_exit(length=20, atr_length=5, multiplier=3.0)()

# Entry signal: Close breaks above Donchian upper band
long_entry = close > dc_upper

# Exit signals
chandelier_exit_signal = crossunder(close, chandelier_long)
technical_exit = close < dc_lower
exit_signal = chandelier_exit_signal or technical_exit

# Use hold_until to maintain position from entry to exit
in_position = hold_until()(enter=long_entry, exit=exit_signal)

# Position zone - long only strategy
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=in_position)

# Risk-based position sizing
# Risk 2% per trade, stop distance = 3 × ATR(5)
stop_distance = 3.0 * atr_5
risk_unit(stop_unit="price")(risk_pct=2.0, stop_distance=stop_distance)

# Event markers for trade signals
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Trade Signals",
        icon=Icon.TargetIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Long Entry", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(title="Chandelier Exit", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title="Technical Exit", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat)
        ]
    )
)(long_entry, chandelier_exit_signal, technical_exit)

# Visualization - Price with Donchian Channel and Chandelier Stop
timeseries_lines(
    title="Donchian Channel & Chandelier Stop",
    category="Price Action",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="DC Upper", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="DC Lower", color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Chandelier Stop", color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(close, dc_upper, dc_lower, chandelier_long)

# ATR indicator panel
timeseries_lines(
    title="ATR (5-period)",
    category="Volatility",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ATR", color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(atr_5)
